snippet.title: Squadron 42 | Inside CIG: Community Gameplay Event
snippet.description:
Join us for a look back at our recent Squadron 42 community event in Manchester, England, where players got their hands on the game for the very first time. Featuring gameplay captured directly from attendees' play sessions, along with a behind-the-scenes glimpse at the weekend that brought it all together.

Wishlist Squadron 42 now, on Steam and squadron42.com
